title: World Soccer Winning Eleven
sources: own RAM search with gbaverify (no RA notes for this hash): the match clock minute 16 -> 25 (France - Czech Republic, first half) matched a byte at 0x03001E1C (only match)

widgets.text:
Score, time, possession per match
Konami's football game (the GBA Winning Eleven, Japanese release with an English patch)
Match clock, score and stamina of your players

Players with stats; formations and strategies
Short pass, long pass, shoot and sprint; switch the controlled player near the ball
Formations and strategies in the team menu change how the CPU teammates play

Pass and through-ball (with direction) to open defenses
Pass around the defence rather than dribbling into it; through balls split two defenders
Shoot from inside the box; power shots from distance rarely score

Exhibition, League, Cup
Modes include exhibition, league and a round-robin CPU match mode (from the menu text)

National and club teams
National teams with real-style rosters of the era

League/cup progress
League standings and cup progress
Round-robin mode plays every team once
English translation in the Translations folder; version 0.99 (from the file name)
